1138	def agg_loss(
1139	    loss_mat: torch.Tensor,
1140	    loss_mask: torch.Tensor,
1141	    loss_agg_mode: str,
1142	    dp_size: int = 1,
1143	    batch_num_tokens: Optional[int] = None,
1144	    global_batch_size: Optional[int] = None,
1145	    loss_scale_factor: Optional[int] = None,
1146	):
1147	    """
1148	    Aggregate the loss across global batch to ensure the loss is invariant to fsdp/megatron parallelism.
1149	
1150	    NOTE: The returned loss has different behaviors for different backend:
1151	    - FSDP: the loss is directly used for backward.
1152	    - Megatron: the loss should be scaled by `num_microbatches` and `cp_size` for pp schedule.
1153	
1154	    Args:
1155	        loss_mat: micro batch loss matrix, (bs, response_length)
1156	        loss_mask: micro batch loss mask, (bs, response_length)
1157	        loss_agg_mode: method to aggregate the loss matrix into a scalar
1158	        dp_size: data parallel size
1159	        batch_num_tokens: number of valid tokens in global batch
1160	        global_batch_size: global batch size
1161	        loss_scale_factor: scale factor for "seq-mean-token-sum-norm" mode. If None, uses loss_mask.shape[-1].
1162	            Set this to a constant value to ensure consistent normalization throughout training.
1163	
1164	    Returns:
1165	        loss: `a scalar torch.Tensor`
1166	            aggregated loss
1167	    """
1168	    if loss_agg_mode == "token-mean":
1169	        if batch_num_tokens is None:
1170	            if dp_size > 1:
1171	                raise ValueError("(global) batch_num_tokens is required when dp_size > 1")
1172	            batch_num_tokens = loss_mask.sum()
1173	        loss = verl_F.masked_sum(loss_mat, loss_mask) / batch_num_tokens * dp_size
1174	    elif loss_agg_mode == "token-sum":
1175	        # DDP/FSDP average gradients across data-parallel ranks. Scaling each
1176	        # rank's local token sum by dp_size makes the reduced gradient equal to
1177	        # the sum over all valid tokens in the global batch.
1178	        loss = verl_F.masked_sum(loss_mat, loss_mask) * dp_size
1179	    elif loss_agg_mode in ["seq-mean-token-sum", "seq-mean-token-sum-norm"]:
1180	        seq_losses = torch.sum(loss_mat * loss_mask, dim=-1)  # token-sum
1181	        seq_mask = (torch.sum(loss_mask, dim=-1) > 0).float()  # exclude fully masked sequences
1182	        if global_batch_size is None:
1183	            if dp_size > 1:
1184	                raise ValueError("global_batch_size is required when dp_size > 1")
1185	            global_batch_size = seq_mask.sum()
1186	        loss = verl_F.masked_sum(seq_losses, seq_mask) / global_batch_size * dp_size  # seq-mean
1187	        if loss_agg_mode == "seq-mean-token-sum-norm":
1188	            if loss_scale_factor is None:
1189	                horizon = loss_mask.shape[-1]
1190	                loss_scale_factor = horizon
1191	            loss /= loss_scale_factor
1192	    elif loss_agg_mode == "seq-mean-token-mean":
1193	        seq_mask = torch.sum(loss_mask, dim=-1)  # per-sequence token count
1194	        seq_losses = torch.sum(loss_mat * loss_mask, dim=-1) / (seq_mask + 1e-8)  # token-mean
1195	        seq_mask = (seq_mask > 0).float()  # exclude fully masked sequences
1196	        if global_batch_size is None:
1197	            if dp_size > 1:
1198	                raise ValueError("global_batch_size is required when dp_size > 1")
1199	            global_batch_size = seq_mask.sum()
1200	        loss = verl_F.masked_sum(seq_losses, seq_mask) / global_batch_size * dp_size  # seq-mean
1201	    else:
1202	        raise ValueError(f"Invalid loss_agg_mode: {loss_agg_mode}")
1203	
1204	    return loss

1207	@deprecated("verl.trainer.ppo.core_algos.compute_policy_loss_vanilla")
1208	def compute_policy_loss(
1209	    old_log_prob,
1210	    log_prob,
1211	    advantages,
1212	    response_mask,
1213	    cliprange=None,
1214	    cliprange_low=None,
1215	    cliprange_high=None,
1216	    clip_ratio_c=3.0,
1217	    loss_agg_mode: str = "token-mean",
1218	):
1219	    """
1220	    Compute the clipped policy objective and related metrics for PPO.
1221	
1222	    Adapted from
1223	    https://github.com/huggingface/trl/blob/main/trl/trainer/ppo_trainer.py#L1122
1224	
1225	    Args:
1226	        old_log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1227	            Log-probabilities of actions under the old policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1228	        log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1229	            Log-probabilities of actions under the current policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1230	        advantages (torch.Tensor):
1231	            Advantage estimates for each action, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1232	        response_mask (torch.Tensor):
1233	            Mask indicating which tokens to include in the loss, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1234	        cliprange (float, optional):
1235	            Clipping parameter ε for standard PPO. See https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.06347.
1236	            Defaults to None (must be provided).
1237	        cliprange_low (float, optional):
1238	            Lower clip range for dual-clip PPO. Defaults to same as `cliprange`.
1239	        cliprange_high (float, optional):
1240	            Upper clip range for dual-clip PPO. Defaults to same as `cliprange`.
1241	        clip_ratio_c (float, optional):
1242	            Lower bound of the ratio for dual-clip PPO. See https://arxiv.org/pdf/1912.09729.
1243	            Defaults to 3.0.
1244	        loss_agg_mode (str, optional):
1245	            Aggregation mode for `agg_loss`. Defaults to "token-mean".
1246	    """
1247	    assert clip_ratio_c > 1.0, (
1248	        "The lower bound of the clip_ratio_c for dual-clip PPO should be greater than 1.0,"
1249	        + f" but get the value: {clip_ratio_c}."
1250	    )
1251	
1252	    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
1253	    # Clamp negative_approx_kl for stability
1254	    negative_approx_kl = torch.clamp(negative_approx_kl, min=-20.0, max=20.0)
1255	    ratio = torch.exp(negative_approx_kl)
1256	    ppo_kl = verl_F.masked_mean(-negative_approx_kl, response_mask)
1257	
1258	    pg_losses1 = -advantages * ratio
1259	    if cliprange_low is None:
1260	        cliprange_low = cliprange
1261	    if cliprange_high is None:
1262	        cliprange_high = cliprange
1263	    pg_losses2 = -advantages * torch.clamp(
1264	        ratio, 1 - cliprange_low, 1 + cliprange_high
1265	    )  # - clip(ratio, 1-cliprange, 1+cliprange) * A
1266	    clip_pg_losses1 = torch.maximum(
1267	        pg_losses1, pg_losses2
1268	    )  # max(-ratio * A, -clip(ratio, 1-cliprange, 1+cliprange) * A)
1269	    pg_clipfrac = verl_F.masked_mean(torch.gt(pg_losses2, pg_losses1).float(), response_mask)
1270	
1271	    pg_losses3 = -advantages * clip_ratio_c
1272	    clip_pg_losses2 = torch.min(pg_losses3, clip_pg_losses1)
1273	    pg_clipfrac_lower = verl_F.masked_mean(
1274	        torch.gt(clip_pg_losses1, pg_losses3) * (advantages < 0).float(), response_mask
1275	    )
1276	
1277	    pg_losses = torch.where(advantages < 0, clip_pg_losses2, clip_pg_losses1)
1278	    pg_loss = agg_loss(loss_mat=pg_losses, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode)
1279	
1280	    return pg_loss, pg_clipfrac, ppo_kl, pg_clipfrac_lower

1378	def compute_policy_loss_dppo_tv(
1379	    old_log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1380	    log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1381	    advantages: torch.Tensor,
1382	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
1383	    loss_agg_mode: str = "token-mean",
1384	    config: Optional[ActorConfig] = None,
1385	    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor | None = None,
1386	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, Any]]:
1387	    """
1388	    Compute the clipped policy objective and related metrics for DPPO-Binary-TV.
1389	
1390	    See https://arxiv.org/pdf/2602.04879 for more details.
1391	
1392	    Args:
1393	        old_log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1394	            Log-probabilities of actions under the old policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1395	        log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1396	            Log-probabilities of actions under the current policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1397	        advantages (torch.Tensor):
1398	            Advantage estimates for each action, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1399	        response_mask (torch.Tensor):
1400	            Mask indicating which tokens to include in the loss, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1401	        loss_agg_mode (str, optional):
1402	            Aggregation mode for `agg_loss`. Defaults to "token-mean".
1403	        config: `(verl.trainer.config.ActorConfig)`:
1404	            config for the actor.
1405	        rollout_log_probs: `(torch.Tensor)`:
1406	            log probabilities of actions under the rollout policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1407	    """
1408	
1409	    assert config is not None
1410	    assert not isinstance(config, AlgoConfig)
1411	    # Note: the clip_ratio is different from the standard PPO, it is the TV divergence threshold for DPPO.
1412	    clip_divergence = config.clip_ratio
1413	    clip_divergence_low = config.clip_ratio_low if config.clip_ratio_low is not None else clip_divergence
1414	    clip_divergence_high = config.clip_ratio_high if config.clip_ratio_high is not None else clip_divergence
1415	
1416	    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
1417	    # Clamp negative_approx_kl for stability
1418	    negative_approx_kl = torch.clamp(negative_approx_kl, min=-20.0, max=20.0)
1419	    ratio = torch.exp(negative_approx_kl)
1420	    ppo_kl = verl_F.masked_mean(-negative_approx_kl, response_mask)
1421	
1422	    # Instead of dual-clip PPO, we use truncated importance sampling (TIS) to clip the policy loss.
1423	    # However, a large threshold is recommended to avoid performance degradation due to the truncation bias.
1424	    # See Section 5.4 in https://arxiv.org/pdf/2602.04879 for more details.
1425	    clip_ratio_c = config.get("clip_ratio_c", 20.0)
1426	    truncated_ratio = torch.clamp(ratio, max=clip_ratio_c)
1427	    truncated_ratio = truncated_ratio.detach()
1428	
1429	    # Compute valid mask for DPPO-Binary-TV
1430	    prob = torch.exp(log_prob)
1431	    old_prob = torch.exp(old_log_prob)
1432	    valid_positive_mask = (prob - old_prob) <= clip_divergence_high
1433	    valid_negative_mask = (prob - old_prob) >= -clip_divergence_low
1434	    valid_mask = torch.where(advantages > 0, valid_positive_mask, valid_negative_mask)
1435	    valid_mask = valid_mask.detach().float()
1436	
1437	    pg_losses = -advantages * truncated_ratio * log_prob * valid_mask
1438	
1439	    # Apply rollout correction weights if provided
1440	    if rollout_is_weights is not None:
1441	        pg_losses = pg_losses * rollout_is_weights
1442	
1443	    pg_loss = agg_loss(
1444	        loss_mat=pg_losses, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode, **config.global_batch_info
1445	    )
1446	
1447	    pg_clipfrac = verl_F.masked_mean((1.0 - valid_mask).float(), response_mask)
1448	    pg_clipfrac_lower = verl_F.masked_mean((ratio > clip_ratio_c).float() * valid_mask, response_mask)
1449	
1450	    pg_metrics = {
1451	        "actor/pg_clipfrac": pg_clipfrac.detach().item(),
1452	        "actor/ppo_kl": ppo_kl.detach().item(),
1453	        "actor/pg_clipfrac_lower": pg_clipfrac_lower.detach().item(),
1454	    }
1455	    return pg_loss, pg_metrics

1460	    old_log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1461	    log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1462	    advantages: torch.Tensor,
1463	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
1464	    loss_agg_mode: str = "token-mean",
1465	    config: Optional[ActorConfig] = None,
1466	    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor | None = None,
1467	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, Any]]:
1468	    """
1469	    Compute the clipped policy objective and related metrics for DPPO-Binary-KL.
1470	
1471	    See https://arxiv.org/pdf/2602.04879 for more details.
1472	
1473	    Args:
1474	        old_log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1475	            Log-probabilities of actions under the old policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1476	        log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1477	            Log-probabilities of actions under the current policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1478	        advantages (torch.Tensor):
1479	            Advantage estimates for each action, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1480	        response_mask (torch.Tensor):
1481	            Mask indicating which tokens to include in the loss, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1482	        loss_agg_mode (str, optional):
1483	            Aggregation mode for `agg_loss`. Defaults to "token-mean".
1484	        config: `(verl.trainer.config.ActorConfig)`:
1485	            config for the actor.
1486	        rollout_log_probs: `(torch.Tensor)`:
1487	            log probabilities of actions under the rollout policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1488	    """
1489	
1490	    assert config is not None
1491	    assert not isinstance(config, AlgoConfig)
1492	    # Note: the clip_ratio is different from the standard PPO, it is the KL divergence threshold for DPPO.
1493	    clip_divergence = config.clip_ratio
1494	    clip_divergence_low = config.clip_ratio_low if config.clip_ratio_low is not None else clip_divergence
1495	    clip_divergence_high = config.clip_ratio_high if config.clip_ratio_high is not None else clip_divergence
1496	
1497	    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
1498	    # Clamp negative_approx_kl for stability
1499	    negative_approx_kl = torch.clamp(negative_approx_kl, min=-20.0, max=20.0)
1500	    ratio = torch.exp(negative_approx_kl)
1501	    ppo_kl = verl_F.masked_mean(-negative_approx_kl, response_mask)
1502	
1503	    # Instead of dual-clip PPO, we use truncated importance sampling (TIS) to clip the policy loss.
1504	    # However, a large threshold is recommended to avoid performance degradation due to the truncation bias.
1505	    # See Section 5.4 in https://arxiv.org/pdf/2602.04879 for more details.
1506	    clip_ratio_c = config.get("clip_ratio_c", 20.0)
1507	    truncated_ratio = torch.clamp(ratio, max=clip_ratio_c)
1508	    truncated_ratio = truncated_ratio.detach()
1509	
1510	    # Compute valid mask for DPPO-Binary-KL
1511	    prob = torch.exp(log_prob)
1512	    old_prob = torch.exp(old_log_prob)
1513	    binary_kl = old_prob * (old_log_prob - log_prob) + (1 - old_prob) * torch.log(
1514	        (1.0 - old_prob + 1e-8) / (1.0 - prob + 1e-8)
1515	    )
1516	    valid_positive_mask = (binary_kl <= clip_divergence_high) | (prob <= old_prob)
1517	    valid_negative_mask = (binary_kl <= clip_divergence_low) | (prob >= old_prob)
1518	    valid_mask = torch.where(advantages > 0, valid_positive_mask, valid_negative_mask)
1519	    valid_mask = valid_mask.detach().float()
1520	
1521	    pg_losses = -advantages * truncated_ratio * log_prob * valid_mask
1522	
1523	    # Apply rollout correction weights if provided
1524	    if rollout_is_weights is not None:
1525	        pg_losses = pg_losses * rollout_is_weights
1526	
1527	    pg_loss = agg_loss(
1528	        loss_mat=pg_losses, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode, **config.global_batch_info
1529	    )
1530	
1531	    # For compatibility, return zero for pg_clipfrac_lower (not used in standard DPPO)
1532	    pg_clipfrac = verl_F.masked_mean((1.0 - valid_mask).float(), response_mask)
1533	    pg_clipfrac_lower = verl_F.masked_mean((ratio > clip_ratio_c).float() * valid_mask, response_mask)
1534	
1535	    pg_metrics = {
1536	        "actor/pg_clipfrac": pg_clipfrac.detach().item(),
1537	        "actor/ppo_kl": ppo_kl.detach().item(),
1538	        "actor/pg_clipfrac_lower": pg_clipfrac_lower.detach().item(),
1539	    }
1540	    return pg_loss, pg_metrics

1543	@register_policy_loss("gspo")
1544	def compute_policy_loss_gspo(
1545	    old_log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1546	    log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1547	    advantages: torch.Tensor,
1548	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
1549	    loss_agg_mode: str = "seq-mean-token-mean",
1550	    config: Optional[ActorConfig] = None,
1551	    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor | None = None,
1552	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, Any]]:
1553	    """
1554	    Compute the clipped policy objective and related metrics for GSPO.
1555	
1556	    See https://arxiv.org/pdf/2507.18071 for more details.
1557	
1558	    Args:
1559	        old_log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1560	            Log-probabilities of actions under the old policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1561	        log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1562	            Log-probabilities of actions under the current policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1563	        advantages (torch.Tensor):
1564	            Advantage estimates for each action, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1565	        response_mask (torch.Tensor):
1566	            Mask indicating which tokens to include in the loss, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1567	        loss_agg_mode (str, optional):
1568	            Aggregation mode for `agg_loss`. For GSPO, it is recommended to use "seq-mean-token-mean".
1569	    """
1570	
1571	    assert config is not None
1572	    assert isinstance(config, ActorConfig)
1573	    clip_ratio_low = config.clip_ratio_low if config.clip_ratio_low is not None else config.clip_ratio
1574	    clip_ratio_high = config.clip_ratio_high if config.clip_ratio_high is not None else config.clip_ratio
1575	
1576	    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
1577	
1578	    # compute sequence-level importance ratio:
1579	    # si(θ) = (π_θ(yi|x)/π_θold(yi|x))^(1/|yi|) =
1580	    # exp [(1/|y_i|) * Σ_t log(π_θ(y_i,t|x,y_i,<t)/π_θold(y_i,t|x,y_i,<t))]
1581	    seq_lengths = torch.sum(response_mask, dim=-1).clamp(min=1)
1582	    negative_approx_kl_seq = torch.sum(negative_approx_kl * response_mask, dim=-1) / seq_lengths
1583	
1584	    # Combined ratio at token level:
1585	    # s_i,t(θ) = sg[s_i(θ)] · π_θ(y_i,t|x, y_i,<t) / sg[π_θ(y_i,t|x, y_i,<t)]
1586	    # In log space: log(s_i,t(θ)) = sg[log(s_i(θ))] + log_prob - sg[log_prob]
1587	    log_seq_importance_ratio = log_prob - log_prob.detach() + negative_approx_kl_seq.detach().unsqueeze(-1)
1588	    log_seq_importance_ratio = torch.clamp(log_seq_importance_ratio, max=10.0)  # clamp for numerical stability
1589	
1590	    # finaly exp() to remove log
1591	    seq_importance_ratio = torch.exp(log_seq_importance_ratio)
1592	
1593	    pg_losses1 = -advantages * seq_importance_ratio
1594	    pg_losses2 = -advantages * torch.clamp(seq_importance_ratio, 1 - clip_ratio_low, 1 + clip_ratio_high)
1595	    pg_losses = torch.maximum(pg_losses1, pg_losses2)
1596	
1597	    # Apply rollout correction weights if provided
1598	    if rollout_is_weights is not None:
1599	        pg_losses = pg_losses * rollout_is_weights
1600	
1601	    # for GSPO, we need to aggregate the loss at the sequence level (seq-mean-token-mean)
1602	    pg_loss = agg_loss(
1603	        loss_mat=pg_losses, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode="seq-mean-token-mean", **config.global_batch_info
1604	    )
1605

1609	
1610	    ppo_kl = verl_F.masked_mean(-negative_approx_kl, response_mask)

1612	        "actor/pg_clipfrac": pg_clipfrac.detach().item(),

1619	@register_policy_loss("sapo")
1620	def compute_policy_loss_sapo(
1621	    old_log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1622	    log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1623	    advantages: torch.Tensor,
1624	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
1625	    loss_agg_mode: str = "seq-mean-token-mean",
1626	    config: Optional[ActorConfig] = None,
1627	    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor | None = None,
1628	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, Any]]:
1629	    """
1630	    Compute the smoothed policy objective and related metrics for SAPO.
1631	
1632	    See https://arxiv.org/pdf/2511.20347 for more details.
1633	
1634	    Args:
1635	        old_log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1636	            Log-probabilities of actions under the old policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1637	        log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1638	            Log-probabilities of actions under the current policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1639	        advantages (torch.Tensor):
1640	            Advantage estimates for each action, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1641	        response_mask (torch.Tensor):
1642	            Mask indicating which tokens to include in the loss, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1643	        loss_agg_mode (str, optional):
1644	            Aggregation mode for `agg_loss`. For SAPO, it is recommended to use "seq-mean-token-mean".
1645	    """
1646	
1647	    assert config is not None
1648	    assert isinstance(config, ActorConfig)
1649	
1650	    # temperature for positive and negative token updates
1651	    tau_pos = torch.as_tensor(config.tau_pos, dtype=advantages.dtype, device=advantages.device)
1652	    tau_neg = torch.as_tensor(config.tau_neg, dtype=advantages.dtype, device=advantages.device)
1653	
1654	    def gate_function(x, tau):
1655	        """The gating function used in SAPO"""
1656	        return torch.sigmoid(tau * (x - 1.0)) * (4.0 / tau)
1657	
1658	    # compute IS at token level:
1659	    # r_{i,t}(θ) = π_θ(y_{i,t}|x, y_{i,<t}) / π_θold(y_{i,t}|x, y_{i,<t})]
1660	    # In log space: log(r_{i,t}(θ)) = log_prob - ol_log_prob
1661	    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
1662	    # Clamp negative_approx_kl for stability
1663	    negative_approx_kl = torch.clamp(negative_approx_kl, min=-20.0, max=20.0)
1664	    # finally exp() to remove log and get r_{i,t}(θ)
1665	    ratio = torch.exp(negative_approx_kl)
1666	
1667	    # tau_{i,t} is tau_pos if adv > 0 else tau_neg
1668	    taus = torch.where(
1669	        condition=advantages > 0,
1670	        input=tau_pos,  # if A_{i,t} > 0 we set to tau_pos
1671	        other=tau_neg,  # if A_{i,t} <= 0 we set to tau_neg
1672	    )
1673	
1674	    # compute the gates f_{i,t}(r_{i,t}(θ)) at token level
1675	    gates = gate_function(ratio, taus)
1676	
1677	    # compute policy gradient loss
1678	    pg_losses = -gates * advantages
1679	
1680	    # Apply rollout correction weights if provided
1681	    if rollout_is_weights is not None:
1682	        pg_losses = pg_losses * rollout_is_weights
1683	
1684	    # for SAPO, we need to aggregate the loss at the sequence level (seq-mean-token-mean)
1685	    pg_loss = agg_loss(
1686	        loss_mat=pg_losses, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode="seq-mean-token-mean", **config.global_batch_info
1687	    )
1688	
1689	    # For compatibility, return zero for both pg_clipfrac and pg_clipfrac_lower (not used in SAPO)
1690	    pg_clipfrac = torch.tensor(0.0, device=pg_loss.device)
1691	    pg_clipfrac_lower = torch.tensor(0.0, device=pg_loss.device)
1692	    # compute KL for metrics tracking
1693	    ppo_kl = verl_F.masked_mean(-negative_approx_kl, response_mask)
1694	    # return metrics dict
1695	    pg_metrics = {
1696	        "actor/pg_clipfrac": pg_clipfrac.detach().item(),
1697	        "actor/ppo_kl": ppo_kl.detach().item(),
1698	        "actor/pg_clipfrac_lower": pg_clipfrac_lower.detach().item(),
1699	    }
1700	
1701	    return pg_loss, pg_metrics

1740	@register_policy_loss("clip_cov")
1741	def compute_policy_loss_clip_cov(
1742	    old_log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1743	    log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1744	    advantages: torch.Tensor,
1745	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
1746	    loss_agg_mode: str = "token-mean",
1747	    config: Optional[ActorConfig] = None,
1748	    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor | None = None,
1749	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, Any]]:
1750	    """
1751	    Compute the clipped policy objective and related metrics for Clip-Cov.
1752	
1753	    Adapted from
1754	    https://github.com/PRIME-RL/Entropy-Mechanism-of-RL/blob/main/verl/trainer/ppo/core_algos.py
1755	
1756	    Args:
1757	        old_log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1758	            Log-probabilities of actions under the old policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1759	        log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1760	            Log-probabilities of actions under the current policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1761	        advantages (torch.Tensor):
1762	            Advantage estimates for each action, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1763	        response_mask (torch.Tensor):
1764	            Mask indicating which tokens to include in the loss, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1765	        cliprange (float, optional):
1766	            Clipping parameter ε for standard PPO. See https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.06347.
1767	            Defaults to None (must be provided).
1768	        cliprange_low (float, optional):
1769	            Lower clip range for dual-clip PPO. Defaults to same as `cliprange`.
1770	        cliprange_high (float, optional):
1771	            Upper clip range for dual-clip PPO. Defaults to same as `cliprange`.
1772	        loss_agg_mode (str, optional):
1773	            Aggregation mode for `agg_loss`. Defaults to "token-mean".
1774	        clip_cov_ratio (float, optional):
1775	            Ratio for clipping the covariance. Defaults to 0.0002.
1776	        clip_cov_lb (float, optional):
1777	            Lower bound for clipping covariance. Defaults to 1.0.
1778	        clip_cov_ub (float, optional):
1779	            Upper bound for clipping covariance. Defaults to 5.0.
1780	    """
1781	    assert config is not None
1782	    assert not isinstance(config, AlgoConfig), "passing AlgoConfig not supported yet"
1783	    assert config.policy_loss is not None
1784	
1785	    clip_cov_ratio = config.policy_loss.clip_cov_ratio if config.policy_loss.clip_cov_ratio is not None else 0.0002
1786	    cliprange = config.clip_ratio
1787	    cliprange_low = config.clip_ratio_low if config.clip_ratio_low is not None else cliprange
1788	    cliprange_high = config.clip_ratio_high if config.clip_ratio_high is not None else cliprange
1789	    clip_cov_ub = config.policy_loss.clip_cov_ub if config.policy_loss.clip_cov_ub is not None else 5.0
1790	    clip_cov_lb = config.policy_loss.clip_cov_lb if config.policy_loss.clip_cov_lb is not None else 1.0
1791	
1792	    assert clip_cov_ratio > 0, "clip_ratio should be larger than 0."
1793	
1794	    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
1795	    ratio = torch.exp(negative_approx_kl)
1796	    ppo_kl = verl_F.masked_mean(-negative_approx_kl, response_mask)
1797	
1798	    pg_losses1 = -advantages * ratio
1799	
1800	    if cliprange_low is None:
1801	        cliprange_low = cliprange
1802	    if cliprange_high is None:
1803	        cliprange_high = cliprange
1804	
1805	    corr = torch.ones_like(advantages)
1806	    pg_losses2 = -advantages * torch.clamp(ratio, 1 - cliprange_low, 1 + cliprange_high)
1807	    clip_by_origin = (pg_losses2 > pg_losses1) & (response_mask > 0)
1808	
1809	    cov_all = (advantages - verl_F.masked_mean(advantages, response_mask)) * (
1810	        log_prob - verl_F.masked_mean(log_prob.detach(), response_mask)
1811	    )
1812	    cov_all[response_mask == 0] = -torch.inf
1813	    cov_all[clip_by_origin] = -torch.inf
1814	
1815	    clip_num = max(int(clip_cov_ratio * response_mask.sum().item()), 1)
1816	    top_k_idx = (cov_all < clip_cov_ub) & (cov_all > clip_cov_lb) & (response_mask > 0)
1817	    top_k_idx = torch.nonzero(top_k_idx)
1818	
1819	    if len(top_k_idx) > 0:
1820	        perm = torch.randperm(len(top_k_idx))
1821	        top_k_idx = top_k_idx[perm[: min(clip_num, len(top_k_idx))]]
1822	    else:
1823	        top_k_idx = torch.empty((0, 2), device=cov_all.device, dtype=torch.long)
1824	
1825	    corr[top_k_idx[:, 0], top_k_idx[:, 1]] = 0
1826	
1827	    pg_clipfrac = verl_F.masked_mean((corr == 0).float(), response_mask)
1828	
1829	    pg_losses = torch.maximum(pg_losses1, pg_losses2) * corr
1830	
1831	    # Apply rollout correction weights if provided
1832	    if rollout_is_weights is not None:
1833	        pg_losses = pg_losses * rollout_is_weights
1834	
1835	    pg_loss = agg_loss(
1836	        loss_mat=pg_losses, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode, **config.global_batch_info
1837	    )
1838	    pg_metrics = {
1839	        "actor/pg_clipfrac": pg_clipfrac.detach().item(),
1840	        "actor/ppo_kl": ppo_kl.detach().item(),
1841	    }
1842	    return pg_loss, pg_metrics
1843

1845	@register_policy_loss("kl_cov")
1846	def compute_policy_loss_kl_cov(
1847	    old_log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1848	    log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1849	    advantages: torch.Tensor,
1850	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
1851	    loss_agg_mode: str = "token-mean",
1852	    config: Optional[ActorConfig] = None,
1853	    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor | None = None,
1854	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, Any]]:
1855	    """
1856	    Compute the clipped policy objective and related metrics for Clip-Cov.
1857	
1858	    Adapted from
1859	    https://github.com/PRIME-RL/Entropy-Mechanism-of-RL/blob/main/verl/trainer/ppo/core_algos.py
1860	
1861	    Args:
1862	        old_log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1863	            Log-probabilities of actions under the old policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1864	        log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1865	            Log-probabilities of actions under the current policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1866	        advantages (torch.Tensor):
1867	            Advantage estimates for each action, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1868	        response_mask (torch.Tensor):
1869	            Mask indicating which tokens to include in the loss, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1870	        loss_agg_mode (str, optional):
1871	            Aggregation mode for `agg_loss`. Defaults to "token-mean".
1872	        kl_cov_ratio (float, optional):
1873	            Ratio for selecting the top-k covariance values. Defaults to 0.0002.
1874	        ppo_kl_coef (float, optional):
1875	            Coefficient for the KL penalty term in the loss. Defaults to 1.
1876	    """
1877	    assert config is not None
1878	    assert not isinstance(config, AlgoConfig), "passing AlgoConfig not supported yet"
1879	    assert config.policy_loss is not None
1880	
1881	    kl_cov_ratio = config.policy_loss.kl_cov_ratio if config.policy_loss.kl_cov_ratio is not None else 0.0002
1882	    ppo_kl_coef = config.policy_loss.ppo_kl_coef if config.policy_loss.ppo_kl_coef is not None else 1.0
1883	
1884	    assert kl_cov_ratio > 0, "kl_cov_ratio should be larger than 0."
1885	
1886	    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
1887	    abs_kl = negative_approx_kl.abs()
1888	    ratio = torch.exp(negative_approx_kl)
1889	    ppo_kl_abs = verl_F.masked_mean(negative_approx_kl.abs(), response_mask)
1890	    pg_losses1 = -advantages * ratio
1891	    pg_losses_kl = -advantages * ratio + ppo_kl_coef * abs_kl
1892	    pg_losses = pg_losses1
1893	
1894	    all_valid = response_mask > 0
1895	    all_valid_idx = torch.nonzero(all_valid.reshape(-1), as_tuple=True)[0]
1896	    all_valid_adv = advantages[all_valid].detach().reshape(-1).cpu()
1897	    all_valid_logp = log_prob[all_valid].detach().reshape(-1).cpu()
1898	
1899	    k = min(kl_cov_ratio, len(all_valid_adv))
1900	
1901	    if k != 0:
1902	        cov_lst_all = (all_valid_adv - all_valid_adv.mean()) * (all_valid_logp - all_valid_logp.mean())
1903	        k_percent_nums = max(1, int(len(cov_lst_all) * kl_cov_ratio))
1904	        large_cov_idxs = torch.topk(cov_lst_all, k_percent_nums, largest=True).indices
1905	
1906	        if len(large_cov_idxs) != 0:
1907	            large_cov_idxs = all_valid_idx[large_cov_idxs]
1908	            pg_losses[large_cov_idxs // advantages.shape[1], large_cov_idxs % advantages.shape[1]] = pg_losses_kl[
1909	                large_cov_idxs // advantages.shape[1], large_cov_idxs % advantages.shape[1]
1910	            ]
1911	
1912	    # Apply rollout correction weights if provided
1913	    if rollout_is_weights is not None:
1914	        pg_losses = pg_losses * rollout_is_weights
1915	
1916	    pg_loss = agg_loss(
1917	        loss_mat=pg_losses, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode, **config.global_batch_info
1918	    )
1919	    pg_metrics = {
1920	        "actor/ppo_kl": ppo_kl_abs.detach().item(),
1921	    }
1922	    return pg_loss, pg_metrics
1923

1925	@register_policy_loss("geo_mean")
1926	def compute_policy_loss_geo_mean(
1927	    old_log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1928	    log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1929	    advantages: torch.Tensor,
1930	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
1931	    loss_agg_mode: str = "token-mean",
1932	    config: Optional[ActorConfig] = None,
1933	    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor | None = None,
1934	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, Any]]:
1935	    """
1936	    Compute the clipped policy objective and related metrics for GMPO.
1937	
1938	    Adapted from paper https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.20673
1939	    https://github.com/callsys/GMPO/blob/main/train_zero_math_gmpo.py
1940	
1941	    Args:
1942	        old_log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1943	            Log-probabilities of actions under the old policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1944	        log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1945	            Log-probabilities of actions under the current policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1946	        advantages (torch.Tensor):
1947	            Advantage estimates for each action, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1948	        response_mask (torch.Tensor):
1949	            Mask indicating which tokens to include in the loss, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1950	        loss_agg_mode (str, optional):
1951	            not used
1952	    """
1953	
1954	    assert config is not None
1955	    assert not isinstance(config, AlgoConfig)
1956	    clip_ratio = config.clip_ratio  # Clipping parameter. See https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.06347.
1957	    clip_ratio_low = config.clip_ratio_low if config.clip_ratio_low is not None else clip_ratio
1958	    clip_ratio_high = config.clip_ratio_high if config.clip_ratio_high is not None else clip_ratio
1959	
1960	    cliprange = clip_ratio
1961	    cliprange_low = clip_ratio_low
1962	    cliprange_high = clip_ratio_high
1963	    if cliprange_low is None:
1964	        cliprange_low = cliprange
1965	    if cliprange_high is None:
1966	        cliprange_high = cliprange
1967	
1968	    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
1969	    # Clamp negative_approx_kl for stability (uncomment it if you like)
1970	    # negative_approx_kl = torch.clamp(negative_approx_kl, min=-20.0, max=20.0)
1971	    ppo_kl = verl_F.masked_mean(-negative_approx_kl, response_mask)
1972	
1973	    # Clipping at token-level & Clipping wider
1974	    sgn_advantage = torch.sign(advantages)
1975	    negative_approx_kl_clamp = torch.clamp(negative_approx_kl, -cliprange_low, cliprange_high)
1976	    negative_approx_kl_min = torch.min(sgn_advantage * negative_approx_kl, sgn_advantage * negative_approx_kl_clamp)
1977	    negative_approx_kl_min = sgn_advantage * negative_approx_kl_min
1978	
1979	    # Geometric-Mean Policy Optimization
1980	    response_mask_sum = response_mask.sum(dim=-1)
1981	    ratio = torch.exp((negative_approx_kl_min * response_mask).sum(dim=-1) / (response_mask_sum + 1e-8))
1982	    # we only support sequence level advantage for now,
1983	    # otherwise, below would be not consistent with the paper
1984	    advantage = (advantages * response_mask).sum(dim=-1) / (response_mask_sum + 1e-8)
1985	    pg_losses = -advantage * ratio
1986	
1987	    # Apply rollout correction weights if provided
1988	    # For geo_mean, IS weights are 2D (batch_size, seq_length) and need to be aggregated to sequence level
1989	    if rollout_is_weights is not None:
1990	        # Aggregate token-level weights to sequence level using geometric mean for consistency
1991	        # Note: rollout_is_weights is always 2D regardless of aggregation mode
1992	        seq_is_weights = torch.exp(
1993	            (torch.log(rollout_is_weights + 1e-10) * response_mask).sum(dim=-1) / (response_mask_sum + 1e-8)
1994	        )
1995	        pg_losses = pg_losses * seq_is_weights
1996	
1997	    pg_loss = torch.mean(pg_losses)
1998	
1999	    # higher: ratio is too large that need clamp to clip_high (when adv > 0)
2000	    clipped = torch.ne(negative_approx_kl, negative_approx_kl_clamp)
2001	    pg_clipfrac = verl_F.masked_mean((clipped * (advantages > 0)).float(), response_mask)
2002	    pg_clipfrac_lower = verl_F.masked_mean((clipped * (advantages < 0)).float(), response_mask)
2003	    pg_metrics = {
2004	        "actor/pg_clipfrac": pg_clipfrac.detach().item(),
2005	        "actor/ppo_kl": ppo_kl.detach().item(),
2006	        "actor/pg_clipfrac_lower": pg_clipfrac_lower.detach().item(),
2007	    }
2008	    return pg_loss, pg_metrics
2009

2011	@register_policy_loss("dro")
2012	def compute_policy_loss_dro(
2013	    old_log_prob: torch.Tensor,
2014	    log_prob: torch.Tensor,
2015	    advantages: torch.Tensor,
2016	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
2017	    loss_agg_mode: str = "token-mean",
2018	    config: Optional[ActorConfig] = None,
2019	    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor | None = None,
2020	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, Any]]:
2021	    """Compute Direct Reward Optimization with a quadratic log-ratio penalty."""
2022	    assert config is not None
2023	    assert config.policy_loss is not None
2024	
2025	    beta = config.policy_loss.dro_beta
2026	    if beta is None or beta <= 0:
2027	        raise ValueError("policy_loss.dro_beta must be a positive value when using DRO")
2028	
2029	    log_ratio = log_prob - old_log_prob
2030	    pg_losses = -(log_prob * advantages - 0.5 * beta * log_ratio.square())
2031	
2032	    if rollout_is_weights is not None:
2033	        pg_losses = pg_losses * rollout_is_weights
2034	
2035	    pg_loss = agg_loss(
2036	        loss_mat=pg_losses, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode, **config.global_batch_info
2037	    )
2038	    pg_metrics = {
2039	        "actor/ppo_kl": verl_F.masked_mean(-log_ratio, response_mask).detach().item(),
2040	    }
2041	    return pg_loss, pg_metrics

2044	@register_policy_loss("cispo")
2045	def compute_policy_loss_cispo(
2046	    old_log_prob: torch.Tensor,
2047	    log_prob: torch.Tensor,
2048	    advantages: torch.Tensor,
2049	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
2050	    loss_agg_mode: str = "token-mean",
2051	    config: Optional[DictConfig | ActorConfig] = None,
2052	    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor | None = None,
2053	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, Any]]:
2054	    """
2055	    Compute the clipped policy objective and related metrics for CISPO.
2056	
2057	    See https://arxiv.org/pdf/2506.13585 for more details.
2058	    """
2059	
2060	    assert config is not None
2061	    assert isinstance(config, ActorConfig)
2062	    clip_ratio_low = config.clip_ratio_low if config.clip_ratio_low is not None else config.clip_ratio
2063	    clip_ratio_high = config.clip_ratio_high if config.clip_ratio_high is not None else config.clip_ratio
2064	
2065	    # Compute importance sampling ratio: π_θ / π_θ_old

"""
Core functions to implement PPO algorithms.
The function implemented in this file should be used by trainer with different distributed strategies to
implement PPO-like algorithms.
"""

__all__ = ["register_adv_est", "get_adv_estimator_fn", "AdvantageEstimator"]

from collections import defaultdict
from enum import Enum
from typing import Any, Callable, Optional

import numpy as np
import torch
from omegaconf import DictConfig

import verl.utils.torch_functional as verl_F
from verl.trainer.config import AlgoConfig
from verl.utils import as_torch_index, group_mean_std
from verl.utils.import_utils import deprecated
from verl.workers.config import ActorConfig

PolicyLossFn = Callable[
    [
        torch.Tensor,  # old_log_prob
        torch.Tensor,  # log_prob
        torch.Tensor,  # advantages
        torch.Tensor,  # response_mask
        str,  # loss_agg_mode
        Optional[DictConfig | ActorConfig],  # config
        torch.Tensor | None,  # rollout_log_probs
    ],
    tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, Any]],
]

POLICY_LOSS_REGISTRY: dict[str, PolicyLossFn] = {}


def register_policy_loss(name: str) -> Callable[[PolicyLossFn], PolicyLossFn]:
    """Register a policy loss function with the given name.

    Args:
        name (str): The name to register the policy loss function under.

    Returns:
        function: Decorator function that registers the policy loss function.
    """

    def decorator(func: PolicyLossFn) -> PolicyLossFn:
        POLICY_LOSS_REGISTRY[name] = func
        return func

    return decorator


def get_policy_loss_fn(name):
    """Get the policy loss with a given name.

    Args:
        name: `(str)`
            The name of the policy loss.

    Returns:
        `(callable)`: The policy loss function.
    """
    loss_name = name
    if loss_name not in POLICY_LOSS_REGISTRY:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Unsupported loss mode: {loss_name}. Supported modes are: {list(POLICY_LOSS_REGISTRY.keys())}"
        )
    return POLICY_LOSS_REGISTRY[loss_name]


class AdvantageEstimator(str, Enum):
    """Using an enumeration class to avoid spelling errors in adv_estimator.

    Note(haibin.lin): this enum class is immutable after creation. Extending this
    enum for new estimators may not be necessary since users can always just call
    `verl.trainer.ppo.core_algos.register` with string name for a custom advantage
    estimator instead.
    """

    GAE = "gae"
    GRPO = "grpo"
    REINFORCE_PLUS_PLUS = "reinforce_plus_plus"
    REINFORCE_PLUS_PLUS_BASELINE = "reinforce_plus_plus_baseline"
    REMAX = "remax"
    RLOO = "rloo"
    OPO = "opo"
    GRPO_PASSK = "grpo_passk"
    GPG = "gpg"
    RLOO_VECTORIZED = "rloo_vectorized"
    GRPO_VECTORIZED = "grpo_vectorized"
    OPTIMAL_TOKEN_BASELINE = "optimal_token_baseline"
    TIR_OPTIMAL_TOKEN_BASELINE = "tir_optimal_token_baseline"
    GDPO = "gdpo"


ADV_ESTIMATOR_REGISTRY: dict[str, Any] = {}


def register_adv_est(name_or_enum: str | AdvantageEstimator) -> Any:
    """Decorator to register a advantage estimator function with a given name.

    Args:
        name_or_enum: `(str)` or `(AdvantageEstimator)`
            The name or enum of the advantage estimator.

    """

    def decorator(fn):
        name = name_or_enum.value if isinstance(name_or_enum, Enum) else name_or_enum
        if name in ADV_ESTIMATOR_REGISTRY and ADV_ESTIMATOR_REGISTRY[name] != fn:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Adv estimator {name} has already been registered: {ADV_ESTIMATOR_REGISTRY[name]} vs {fn}"
            )
        ADV_ESTIMATOR_REGISTRY[name] = fn
        return fn

    return decorator


def get_adv_estimator_fn(name_or_enum):
    """Get the advantage estimator function with a given name.

    Args:
        name_or_enum: `(str)` or `(AdvantageEstimator)`
            The name or enum of the advantage estimator.

    Returns:
        `(callable)`: The advantage estimator function.
    """
    name = name_or_enum.value if isinstance(name_or_enum, Enum) else name_or_enum
    if name not in ADV_ESTIMATOR_REGISTRY:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown advantage estimator simply: {name}")
    return ADV_ESTIMATOR_REGISTRY[name]


class AdaptiveKLController:
    """
    Adaptive KL controller described in the paper:
    https://arxiv.org/pdf/1909.08593.pdf
    """

    def __init__(self, init_kl_coef, target_kl, horizon):
        self.value = init_kl_coef
        self.target = target_kl
        self.horizon = horizon

    def update(self, current_kl, n_steps):
        """Update the KL coefficient based on current KL divergence.

        Args:
            current_kl (float): Current KL divergence value.
            n_steps (int): Number of steps taken.
        """
        target = self.target
        proportional_error = np.clip(current_kl / target - 1, -0.2, 0.2)
        mult = 1 + proportional_error * n_steps / self.horizon
        self.value *= mult


class FixedKLController:
    """Fixed KL controller."""

    def __init__(self, kl_coef):
        self.value = kl_coef

    def update(self, current_kl, n_steps):
        """Update method for fixed KL controller (no-op).

        Args:
            current_kl (float): Current KL divergence value (unused).
            n_steps (int): Number of steps taken (unused).
        """
        pass


def get_kl_controller(kl_ctrl):
    """Factory function to create appropriate KL controller based on configuration.

    Args:
        kl_ctrl: Configuration object containing KL controller settings.

    Returns:
        KL controller instance (FixedKLController or AdaptiveKLController).

    Raises:
        NotImplementedError: If controller type is not supported.
        AssertionError: If adaptive controller horizon is not positive.
    """
    if kl_ctrl.type == "fixed":
        return FixedKLController(kl_coef=kl_ctrl.kl_coef)
    elif kl_ctrl.type == "adaptive":
        assert kl_ctrl.horizon > 0, f"horizon must be larger than 0. Got {kl_ctrl.horizon}"
        return AdaptiveKLController(init_kl_coef=kl_ctrl.kl_coef, target_kl=kl_ctrl.target_kl, horizon=kl_ctrl.horizon)
    else:
        raise NotImplementedError


@register_adv_est(AdvantageEstimator.GAE)  # or simply: @register_adv_est("gae")
def compute_gae_advantage_return(
    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
    values: torch.Tensor,
    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
    gamma: torch.Tensor,
    lam: torch.Tensor,
):
    """Adapted from https://github.com/huggingface/trl/blob/main/trl/trainer/ppo_trainer.py

    Args:
        token_level_rewards: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape is (bs, response_length)
        values: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape is (bs, response_length)
        response_mask: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape is (bs, response_length). [EOS] mask. The token after [EOS] have mask zero.
        gamma is `(float)`
            discounted factor used in RL
        lam: `(float)`
            lambda value when computing Generalized Advantage Estimation (https://arxiv.org/abs/1506.02438)

    Returns:
        advantages: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape: (bs, response_length)
        Returns: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape: (bs, response_length)

    """
    with torch.no_grad():
        nextvalues = 0
        lastgaelam = 0
        advantages_reversed = []
        gen_len = token_level_rewards.shape[-1]

        for t in reversed(range(gen_len)):
            delta = token_level_rewards[:, t] + gamma * nextvalues - values[:, t]
            lastgaelam_ = delta + gamma * lam * lastgaelam

            # skip values and TD-error on observation tokens
            nextvalues = values[:, t] * response_mask[:, t] + (1 - response_mask[:, t]) * nextvalues
            lastgaelam = lastgaelam_ * response_mask[:, t] + (1 - response_mask[:, t]) * lastgaelam

            advantages_reversed.append(lastgaelam)
        advantages = torch.stack(advantages_reversed[::-1], dim=1)

        returns = advantages + values
        advantages = verl_F.masked_whiten(advantages, response_mask)
    return advantages, returns


# NOTE(sgm): this implementation only consider outcome supervision, where the reward is a scalar.
@register_adv_est(AdvantageEstimator.GRPO)  # or simply: @register_adv_est("grpo")
def compute_grpo_outcome_advantage(
    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
    index: np.ndarray,
    epsilon: float = 1e-6,
    norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo: bool = True,
    config: Optional[AlgoConfig] = None,
) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
    """
    Compute advantage for GRPO, operating only on Outcome reward
    (with only one scalar reward for each response).

    Args:
        token_level_rewards: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape is (bs, response_length)
        response_mask: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape is (bs, response_length)
        index: `(np.ndarray)`
            index array for grouping
        epsilon: `(float)`
            small value to avoid division by zero
        norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo: `(bool)`
            whether to scale the GRPO advantage
        config: `(Optional[AlgoConfig])`
            algorithm configuration object

    Note:
        If norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo is True, the advantage is scaled by the std, as in the original GRPO.
        If False, the advantage is not scaled, as in Dr.GRPO (https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.20783).

    Returns:
        advantages: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape is (bs, response_length)
        Returns: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape is (bs, response_length)
    """
    scores = token_level_rewards.sum(dim=-1)

    id2score = defaultdict(list)
    id2mean = {}
    id2std = {}

    with torch.no_grad():
        bsz = scores.shape[0]
        for i in range(bsz):
            id2score[index[i]].append(scores[i])
        for idx in id2score:
            if len(id2score[idx]) == 1:
                id2mean[idx] = torch.tensor(0.0)
                id2std[idx] = torch.tensor(1.0)
            elif len(id2score[idx]) > 1:
                scores_tensor = torch.stack(id2score[idx])
                id2mean[idx] = torch.mean(scores_tensor)
                id2std[idx] = torch.std(scores_tensor)
            else:
                raise ValueError(f"no score in prompt index: {idx}")
        for i in range(bsz):
            if norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo:
                scores[i] = (scores[i] - id2mean[index[i]]) / (id2std[index[i]] + epsilon)
            else:
                scores[i] = scores[i] - id2mean[index[i]]
        scores = scores.unsqueeze(-1) * response_mask

    return scores, scores


@register_adv_est(AdvantageEstimator.GRPO_VECTORIZED)
def compute_grpo_vectorized_outcome_advantage(
    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
    index: np.ndarray,
    epsilon: float = 1e-6,
    norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo: bool = True,
    config: Optional[AlgoConfig] = None,
) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
    """
    Vectorized GRPO（outcome-only）:
      For each group g:
      a_i = \\frac{r_i - \\mu_g}{\\sigma_g} (or without dividing by \\sigma_g),
      then broadcast the scalar across the token dimension (multiplied by response_mask).。
    """
    with torch.no_grad():
        scores = token_level_rewards.sum(dim=-1)
        g = as_torch_index(index, device=scores.device)
        mean_g, std_g, _ = group_mean_std(scores, g, eps=0.0, device=scores.device)
        if norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo:
            scalars = (scores - mean_g[g]) / (std_g[g] + epsilon)
        else:
            scalars = scores - mean_g[g]
        advantages = scalars.unsqueeze(-1) * response_mask
        return advantages, advantages


@register_adv_est(AdvantageEstimator.GDPO)  # or simply: @register_adv_est("gdpo")
def compute_gdpo_outcome_advantage(
    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
    index: np.ndarray,
    epsilon: float = 1e-6,
    norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo: bool = True,
    config: Optional[AlgoConfig] = None,
    non_tensor_batch: Optional[dict] = None,
    batch: Optional[dict] = None,
    **kwargs,
) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
    """
    GDPO: Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization.

    Instead of summing all reward dimensions first (like GRPO), GDPO normalizes
    each reward dimension independently within each group before aggregation.
    This prevents a dominant reward signal from drowning out weaker ones.

    Mathematical formulation:
        Step 1 – Group-wise decoupled normalization (via GRPO per dimension):
            For each reward dimension k, within each group g:
            A_k = (r_k - μ_group(r_k)) / (σ_group(r_k) + ε)

        Step 2 – Weighted aggregation:
            A_sum = Σ_k w_k · A_k

        Step 3 – Batch-level normalization (via masked_whiten):
            A_final = whiten(A_sum, response_mask)

    Args:
        token_level_rewards: (bs, response_length) – standard token-level rewards.
            Used as fallback when per-dimension rewards are not provided.
        response_mask: (bs, response_length)
        index: (bs,) – group id per sample (from ``uid``).
        epsilon: Numerical stability constant.
        norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo: Whether to normalize by std in GRPO.
        config: Algorithm configuration (optional).
        non_tensor_batch: Non-tensor batch data containing per-dimension reward scores.
        batch: Batch data containing prompts, attention_mask, etc.

    Note:
        Ref GDPO (https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.05242).

    Returns:
        advantages: (bs, response_length)
        returns: (bs, response_length) – same as advantages (outcome-only).
    """
    score_list = None
    reward_weights = None

    if config is not None and non_tensor_batch is not None and batch is not None:
        gdpo_reward_keys = config.get("gdpo_reward_keys", None)
        assert gdpo_reward_keys, (
            "GDPO requires 'algorithm.gdpo_reward_keys' listing the individual reward "
            "component keys returned by compute_score (e.g. ['format_reward', 'accuracy_reward'])."
        )
        device = token_level_rewards.device
        prompt_length = batch["prompts"].size(1)
        valid_response_length = batch["attention_mask"][:, prompt_length:].sum(dim=1) - 1

        score_list = []
        for key in gdpo_reward_keys:
            assert key in non_tensor_batch, (
                f"GDPO reward key '{key}' not found in non_tensor_batch. "
                f"Available keys: {list(non_tensor_batch.keys())}. "
                f"Make sure your compute_score returns a dict containing '{key}'."
            )
            comp = non_tensor_batch[key]
            rm_score = torch.tensor(np.asarray(comp, dtype=np.float32), device=device)
            rm_scores = torch.zeros_like(response_mask, dtype=torch.float32)
            rm_scores[torch.arange(rm_scores.size(0), device=device), valid_response_length] = rm_score
            score_list.append(rm_scores)

        gdpo_weights = config.get("gdpo_reward_weights", None)
        if gdpo_weights is not None:
            reward_weights = list(gdpo_weights)

    if score_list is None:
        score_list = [token_level_rewards]

    num_scores = len(score_list)

    if reward_weights is not None:
        weights = torch.tensor(reward_weights, dtype=torch.float32, device=token_level_rewards.device)
    else:
        weights = torch.ones(num_scores, dtype=torch.float32, device=token_level_rewards.device)

    new_advantage = None

    for i in range(num_scores):
        normalized_score, _ = compute_grpo_outcome_advantage(
            token_level_rewards=score_list[i],
            response_mask=response_mask,
            index=index,
            epsilon=epsilon,
            norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo=norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo,
            config=config,
        )

        if new_advantage is None:
            new_advantage = weights[i] * normalized_score
        else:
            new_advantage += weights[i] * normalized_score

    advantages = verl_F.masked_whiten(new_advantage, response_mask) * response_mask

    return advantages, advantages


@register_adv_est(AdvantageEstimator.GRPO_PASSK)  # or simply: @register_adv_est("grpo_passk")
def compute_grpo_passk_outcome_advantage(
    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
    index: np.ndarray,
    epsilon: float = 1e-6,
    norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo: bool = True,
    config: Optional[AlgoConfig] = None,
    **kwargs,
) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
    """
    Compute advantage for Pass@k using a GRPO-style outcome reward formulation.
    Only the best response per group gets a non-zero advantage: r_max - r_second_max.

    Implemented as described in https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.19595.

    Args:
        token_level_rewards: (bs, response_length)
        response_mask: (bs, response_length)
        index: (bs,) → group ID per sample
        epsilon: float for numerical stability
        config: (AlgoConfig) algorithm settings, which contains "norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo"

    Returns:
        advantages: (bs, response_length)
        returns: (bs, response_length)
    """
    assert config is not None
    # if True, normalize advantage by std within group
    norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo = config.get("norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo", True)
    scores = token_level_rewards.sum(dim=-1)  # (bs,)
    advantages = torch.zeros_like(scores)

    id2scores = defaultdict(list)
    id2indices = defaultdict(list)

    with torch.no_grad():
        bsz = scores.shape[0]
        for i in range(bsz):
            idx = index[i]
            id2scores[idx].append(scores[i])
            id2indices[idx].append(i)

        for idx in id2scores:
            rewards = torch.stack(id2scores[idx])  # (k,)
            if rewards.numel() < 2:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Pass@k requires at least 2 samples per group. Got {rewards.numel()} for group {idx}."
                )
            topk, topk_idx = torch.topk(rewards, 2)
            r_max, r_second_max = topk[0], topk[1]
            i_max = id2indices[idx][topk_idx[0].item()]
            advantage = r_max - r_second_max
            if norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo:
                std = torch.std(rewards)
                advantage = advantage / (std + epsilon)
            advantages[i_max] = advantage

    advantages = advantages.unsqueeze(-1) * response_mask
    return advantages, advantages


@register_adv_est(
    AdvantageEstimator.REINFORCE_PLUS_PLUS_BASELINE
)  # or simply: @register_adv_est("reinforce_plus_plus_baseline")
def compute_reinforce_plus_plus_baseline_outcome_advantage(
    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
    index: torch.Tensor,
    epsilon: float = 1e-6,
    config: Optional[AlgoConfig] = None,
    **kwargs,
) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
    """
    Compute advantage for RF++-baseline (https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.03262), operating only on Outcome reward
    (with only one scalar reward for each response).

    Args:
        token_level_rewards: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape: (bs, response_length)
        response_mask: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape: (bs, response_length)
        config: (AlgoConfig) algorithm config

    Returns:
        advantages: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape: (bs, response_length)
        Returns: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape: (bs, response_length)
    """
    response_length = token_level_rewards.shape[-1]
    scores = token_level_rewards.sum(dim=-1)

    id2score = defaultdict(list)
    id2mean = {}

    with torch.no_grad():
        bsz = scores.shape[0]
        for i in range(bsz):
            id2score[index[i]].append(scores[i])
        for idx in id2score:
            if len(id2score[idx]) == 1:
                id2mean[idx] = torch.tensor(0.0)
            elif len(id2score[idx]) > 1:
                id2mean[idx] = torch.mean(torch.stack(id2score[idx]))
            else:
                raise ValueError(f"no score in prompt index: {idx}")
        for i in range(bsz):
            scores[i] = scores[i] - id2mean[index[i]]

        scores = scores.unsqueeze(-1).tile([1, response_length]) * response_mask
        scores = verl_F.masked_whiten(scores, response_mask) * response_mask

    return scores, scores


@register_adv_est(AdvantageEstimator.RLOO)  # or simply: @register_adv_est("rloo")
def compute_rloo_outcome_advantage(
    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
    index: np.ndarray,
    epsilon: float = 1e-6,
    config: Optional[AlgoConfig] = None,
    **kwargs,
) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
    """
    Compute advantage for RLOO based on https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.14740

    Args:
        token_level_rewards: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape: (bs, response_length)
        response_mask: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape: (bs, response_length)
        config: (AlgoConfig) algorithm config

    Returns:
        advantages: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape: (bs, response_length)
        Returns: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape: (bs, response_length)
    """
    scores = token_level_rewards.sum(dim=-1)

    id2score = defaultdict(list)
    id2mean = {}

    with torch.no_grad():
        bsz = scores.shape[0]
        for i in range(bsz):
            id2score[index[i]].append(scores[i])
        for idx in id2score:
            if len(id2score[idx]) == 1:
                id2mean[idx] = torch.tensor(0.0)
            elif len(id2score[idx]) > 1:
                id2mean[idx] = torch.mean(torch.stack(id2score[idx]))
            else:
                raise ValueError(f"no score in prompt index: {idx}")
        for i in range(bsz):
            response_num = len(id2score[index[i]])
            if response_num > 1:
                scores[i] = scores[i] * response_num / (response_num - 1) - id2mean[index[i]] * response_num / (
                    response_num - 1
                )
        scores = scores.unsqueeze(-1) * response_mask

    return scores, scores


@register_adv_est(AdvantageEstimator.OPO)  # or simply: @register_adv_est("opo")
def compute_opo_outcome_advantage(
    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
    index: np.ndarray,
    epsilon: float = 1e-6,
    config: Optional[AlgoConfig] = None,
    **kwargs,
) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
    """
    Compute advantage for OPO based on https://arxiv.org/pdf/2505.23585

    Args:
        token_level_rewards: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape: (bs, response_length)
        response_mask: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape: (bs, response_length)
        config: (AlgoConfig) algorithm config

    Returns:
        advantages: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape: (bs, response_length)
        Returns: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape: (bs, response_length)
    """
    response_length = response_mask.sum(dim=-1)
    scores = token_level_rewards.sum(dim=-1)

    id2score = defaultdict(list)
    id2len = defaultdict(list)
    id2bsl = {}

    with torch.no_grad():
        bsz = scores.shape[0]
        for i in range(bsz):
            id2score[index[i]].append(scores[i])
            id2len[index[i]].append(response_length[i])

        for idx in id2score:
            if len(id2score[idx]) == 1:
                id2bsl[idx] = torch.tensor(0.0)
            elif len(id2score[idx]) > 1:
                score_tensor = torch.stack(id2score[idx])
                len_tensor = torch.stack(id2len[idx])
                id2bsl[idx] = (len_tensor * score_tensor).sum() / len_tensor.sum()
            else:
                raise ValueError(f"no score in prompt index: {idx}")
        for i in range(bsz):
            scores[i] = scores[i] - id2bsl[index[i]]
        scores = scores.unsqueeze(-1) * response_mask

    return scores, scores


@register_adv_est(AdvantageEstimator.REINFORCE_PLUS_PLUS)  # or simply: @register_adv_est("reinforce_plus_plus")
def compute_reinforce_plus_plus_outcome_advantage(
    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor, response_mask: torch.Tensor, config: Optional[AlgoConfig] = None, **kwargs
) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
    """
    Compute advantage for REINFORCE++.
    This implementation is based on the paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.03262

    Args:
        token_level_rewards: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape: (bs, response_length)
        response_mask: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape: (bs, response_length)
        config: (AlgoConfig) algorithm config

    Returns:
        advantages: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape: (bs, response_length)
        Returns: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape: (bs, response_length)
    """
    assert config is not None
    gamma = config.gamma
    with torch.no_grad():
        returns = torch.zeros_like(token_level_rewards)
        running_return = 0

        for t in reversed(range(token_level_rewards.shape[1])):
            running_return = token_level_rewards[:, t] + gamma * running_return
            returns[:, t] = running_return
            # Reset after EOS
            running_return = running_return * response_mask[:, t]

        advantages = verl_F.masked_whiten(returns, response_mask)
        advantages = advantages * response_mask

    return advantages, returns


@register_adv_est(AdvantageEstimator.REMAX)  # or simply: @register_adv_est("remax")
def compute_remax_outcome_advantage(
    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
    reward_baselines: torch.Tensor,
    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
    config: Optional[AlgoConfig] = None,
    **kwargs,
) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
    """
    Compute advantage for ReMax, operating only on Outcome reward
    This implementation is based on the paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.10505
    (with only one scalar reward for each response).

    Args:
        token_level_rewards: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape: (bs, response_length)
        reward_baselines: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape: (bs,)
        response_mask: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape: (bs, response_length)
        config: (AlgoConfig) algorithm config

    Returns:
        advantages: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape: (bs, response_length)
        Returns: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape: (bs, response_length)
    """

    with torch.no_grad():
        returns = (token_level_rewards * response_mask).flip(dims=[-1]).cumsum(dim=-1).flip(dims=[-1])
        advantages = returns - reward_baselines.unsqueeze(-1) * response_mask

    return advantages, returns


@register_adv_est(AdvantageEstimator.GPG)  # or simply: @register_adv_est("gpg")
def compute_gpg_outcome_advantage(
    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
    index: np.ndarray,
    epsilon: float = 1e-6,
    f_norm: float = 1.0,
    alpha: float = 1.0,
    config=None,
    **kwargs,
):
    """
    Compute advantage for GPG, operating only on Outcome reward
    (with only one scalar reward for each response).
    Args:
        token_level_rewards: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape: (bs, response_length)
        response_mask: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape: (bs, response_length)
        index: `(np.ndarray)`
            shape: (bs,)
        epsilon: (float)
        f_norm: (float)
        alpha: (float)
        config: (dict) algorithm config

    Returns:
        advantages: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape: (bs, response_length)
        Returns: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape: (bs, response_length)
    """
    scores = token_level_rewards.sum(dim=-1)

    id2score = defaultdict(list)
    id2mean = {}
    id2std = {}

    with torch.no_grad():
        bsz = scores.shape[0]
        m = torch.count_nonzero(scores)
        alpha = bsz / m.clamp(min=1)

        for i in range(bsz):
            id2score[index[i]].append(scores[i])

        for idx in id2score:
            if len(id2score[idx]) == 1:
                id2mean[idx] = torch.tensor(0.0)
                id2std[idx] = torch.tensor(1.0)
            elif len(id2score[idx]) > 1:
                scores_tensor = torch.stack(id2score[idx])
                id2mean[idx] = torch.mean(scores_tensor)
                id2std[idx] = torch.std(scores_tensor)
            else:
                raise ValueError(f"no score in prompt index: {idx}")
        for i in range(bsz):
            scores[i] = alpha * (scores[i] - id2mean[index[i]]) / (f_norm)
        scores = scores.unsqueeze(-1) * response_mask

    return scores, scores


@register_adv_est(AdvantageEstimator.RLOO_VECTORIZED)  # or simply: @register_adv_est("rloo_vectorized")
def compute_rloo_vectorized_outcome_advantage(
    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
    index: np.ndarray,
    epsilon: float = 1e-6,
    config: Optional[AlgoConfig] = None,
    **kwargs,
) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
    """
    Compute advantage for RLOO based on https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.14740

    Args:
        token_level_rewards: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape: (bs, response_length)
        response_mask: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape: (bs, response_length)
        config: (AlgoConfig) algorithm config

    Returns:
        advantages: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape: (bs, response_length)
        Returns: `(torch.Tensor)`
            shape: (bs, response_length)
    """
    scores = token_level_rewards.sum(dim=-1)

    with torch.no_grad():
        inv = torch.from_numpy(np.unique(index, return_inverse=True)[1]).to(scores.device)

        c = torch.bincount(inv)[inv].to(scores.dtype)
        adv = ((c * scores - torch.bincount(inv, weights=scores)[inv]) / (c - 1).clamp_min(1)) * (c > 1)

        adv = adv.unsqueeze(-1) * response_mask

    return adv, adv


@register_adv_est(AdvantageEstimator.OPTIMAL_TOKEN_BASELINE)
def compute_optimal_token_baseline_advantage(
    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
    index: np.ndarray,
    old_log_probs: torch.Tensor,
    sum_pi_squared: torch.Tensor,
    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor = None,
    handle_zero_tail: bool = True,
    epsilon: float = 1e-8,
    **kwargs,
) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
    """
    Compute advantages using Optimal Token Baseline (OTB).

    Unlike the group mean based baseline which uses a single baseline per trajectory,
    this computes a unique baseline for each timestep using cumulative path variance.

    Theory:
        For each timestep t in each prompt group:
            B_t* = E[G_t × W_t] / E[W_t]
        where W_t = Σ_{j=1}^t ||s_j||² (cumulative path-variance proxy)
        and ||s_j||² = 1 - 2π_j + Σπ²

    The cumulative sum W_t captures the "realized energy" of trajectory has been up to timestep t,
    giving higher weight to predicting rewards on high-variance paths.

    Args:
        token_level_rewards: Rewards at each token position [shape: (bs, response_length)]
        response_mask: Binary mask for valid tokens (1) vs padding (0) [shape: (bs, response_length)]
        index: Prompt indices for grouping trajectories from same prompt [shape: (bs,)]
        old_log_probs: Log probabilities from training policy during generation [shape: (bs, response_length)]
        sum_pi_squared: Sum of squared probabilities over vocabulary Σπ² [shape: (bs, response_length)]
        rollout_is_weights: Pre-computed IS weights for W correction [shape: (bs, response_length)],
            None if not using IS
        handle_zero_tail: If True, zero baselines will be set in the portion of the longest trajectory
            that extends beyond the second-longest trajectory in the prompt group.
            Default: True
        epsilon: Small constant for numerical stability (default: 1e-8)

    Returns:
        advantages: OTB advantage estimates [shape: (bs, response_length)]
        returns: Cumulative rewards (returns) from each position [shape: (bs, response_length)]

    Note on Rollout Importance Sampling:
        When rollout_is_weights is provided, W_t is scaled by ρ̄²(t) to minimize MSE under truncated IS:
            B_t* = Σ[G_t × ρ̄²(t) × W_t] / Σ[ρ̄²(t) × W_t]
    """
    with torch.no_grad():
        batch_size, seq_len = token_level_rewards.shape
        device = token_level_rewards.device

        # Compute returns (reward-to-go) for each timestep
        returns = (token_level_rewards * response_mask).flip(dims=[-1]).cumsum(dim=-1).flip(dims=[-1])

        # Step 1: Compute w_per_timestep = 1 - 2π_t + Σπ²)
        pi_t = torch.exp(old_log_probs)
        w_per_timestep = 1 - 2 * pi_t + sum_pi_squared

        # Step 2: Apply rollout importance sampling correction (if enabled)
        if rollout_is_weights is not None:
            # Scale W by ρ̄² to minimize MSE under truncated IS
            w_per_timestep = w_per_timestep * (rollout_is_weights**2)

        # Step 3: Compute cumulative path-variance proxy: W_t = Σ_{j=1}^t w_j
        # This measures accumulated variance from the start of the trajectory up to timestep t
        w_cumulative = (w_per_timestep * response_mask).cumsum(dim=-1)

        # Group trajectories by prompt
        prompt_groups = defaultdict(list)
        for i in range(batch_size):
            prompt_groups[index[i]].append(i)

        # Initialize baselines tensor [batch_size, seq_len]
        baselines = torch.zeros_like(returns)

        # Compute per-step baseline for each prompt group
        for _, trajectory_indices in prompt_groups.items():
            N = len(trajectory_indices)
            if N == 1:
                # Single trajectory - no baseline (advantage = return)
                continue

            traj_idx = torch.tensor(trajectory_indices, device=device)

            # Extract group data [N, seq_len]
            returns_group = returns[traj_idx]
            w_cumulative_group = w_cumulative[traj_idx]
            mask_group = response_mask[traj_idx]

            # Compute per-timestep baseline: B_t = Σ[G_t × W_t] / Σ[W_t]
            # where W_t = Σ_{j=1}^t ||s_j||² (cumulative path variance)
            # Shape: [seq_len]
            numerator = (returns_group * w_cumulative_group * mask_group).sum(dim=0)  # Sum over trajectories
            denominator = (w_cumulative_group * mask_group).sum(dim=0) + epsilon

            baseline_per_step = numerator / denominator  # [seq_len]

            # Assign to all trajectories in this group
            baselines[traj_idx] = baseline_per_step.unsqueeze(0).expand(N, -1)

            if handle_zero_tail:
                # Optionally zero out the portion of the longest trajectory that extends
                # beyond the second-longest trajectory in the prompt group.
                response_lengths = mask_group.sum(dim=-1)
                sorted_lengths, _ = torch.sort(response_lengths)
                max_length = int(sorted_lengths[-1].item())
                second_max_length = int(sorted_lengths[-2].item())
                max_length_idx = (response_lengths == max_length).nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]
                if max_length_idx.numel() == 1 and max_length > second_max_length:
                    max_length_traj_idx = trajectory_indices[int(max_length_idx[0])]
                    baselines[max_length_traj_idx, second_max_length:] = 0.0

        # Compute advantages: A_t = G_t - B_t
        advantages = (returns - baselines) * response_mask

    return advantages, returns


@register_adv_est(AdvantageEstimator.TIR_OPTIMAL_TOKEN_BASELINE)
def compute_multi_turn_optimal_token_baseline_advantage(
    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
    index: np.ndarray,
    old_log_probs: torch.Tensor,
    sum_pi_squared: torch.Tensor,
    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor = None,
    handle_zero_tail: bool = True,
    epsilon: float = 1e-8,
    **kwargs,
) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
    """
    Compute advantages using Optimal Token Baseline (OTB).

    Unlike the group mean based baseline which uses a single baseline per trajectory,
    this computes a unique baseline for each timestep using cumulative path variance.

    Theory:
        For each timestep t in each prompt group:
            B_t* = E[G_t × W_t] / E[W_t]
        where W_t = Σ_{j=1}^t ||s_j||² (cumulative path-variance proxy)
        and ||s_j||² = 1 - 2π_j + Σπ²

    The cumulative sum W_t captures the "realized energy" of trajectory has been up to timestep t,
    giving higher weight to predicting rewards on high-variance paths.

    Args:
        token_level_rewards: Rewards at each token position [shape: (bs, response_length)]
        response_mask: Binary mask for valid tokens (1) vs padding (0) [shape: (bs, response_length)]
        index: Prompt indices for grouping trajectories from same prompt [shape: (bs,)]
        old_log_probs: Log probabilities from training policy during generation [shape: (bs, response_length)]
        sum_pi_squared: Sum of squared probabilities over vocabulary Σπ² [shape: (bs, response_length)]
        rollout_is_weights: Pre-computed IS weights for W correction [shape: (bs, response_length)],
            None if not using IS
        handle_zero_tail: If True, zero baselines will be set in the portion of the longest trajectory
            that extends beyond the second-longest trajectory in the prompt group.
            Default: False
        epsilon: Small constant for numerical stability (default: 1e-8)

    Returns:
        advantages: OTB advantage estimates [shape: (bs, response_length)]
        returns: Cumulative rewards (returns) from each position [shape: (bs, response_length)]

    Note on Rollout Importance Sampling:
        When rollout_is_weights is provided, W_t is scaled by ρ̄²(t) to minimize MSE under truncated IS:
            B_t* = Σ[G_t × ρ̄²(t) × W_t] / Σ[ρ̄²(t) × W_t]
    """
    with torch.no_grad():
        # Compute returns (reward-to-go) for each timestep
        token_returns = (token_level_rewards * response_mask).flip(dims=[-1]).cumsum(dim=-1).flip(dims=[-1])

        # Step 1: Compute w_per_timestep = 1 - 2π_t + Σπ²)
        pi_t = torch.exp(old_log_probs)
        w_per_timestep = 1 - 2 * pi_t + sum_pi_squared

        # Step 2: Apply rollout importance sampling correction (if enabled)
        if rollout_is_weights is not None:
            # Scale W by ρ̄² to minimize MSE under truncated IS
            w_per_timestep = w_per_timestep * (rollout_is_weights**2)

        # Step 3: Compute cumulative path-variance proxy: W_t = Σ_{j=1}^t w_j
        # This measures accumulated variance from the start of the trajectory up to timestep t
        w_cumulative = (w_per_timestep * response_mask).cumsum(dim=-1)

        # Step 4: Concatenate returns and w_cumulative for each trajectory
        # This allows us to compute baseline per timestep for each trajectory
        response_lengths = response_mask.sum(dim=-1).to(dtype=torch.long)  # [shape: (bs * n, )]
        max_response_length = int(response_lengths.max().item()) if response_lengths.numel() > 0 else 0
        all_w_values = w_cumulative.new_zeros(
            (len(response_lengths), max_response_length)
        )  # [shape: (bs * n, max_response_length)]
        all_returns = torch.zeros_like(all_w_values)
        for i in range(len(response_lengths)):
            length = int(response_lengths[i].item())
            if length == 0:
                continue
            mask = response_mask[i].bool()
            all_w_values[i, :length] = w_cumulative[i, mask]
            all_returns[i, :length] = token_returns[i, mask]

        # Group trajectories by prompt
        prompt_groups = defaultdict(list)
        for i in range(len(response_lengths)):
            if response_lengths[i] == 0:
                continue
            prompt_groups[index[i]].append(i)

        # Compute optimal baseline for each prompt group
        baselines = torch.zeros_like(all_returns)

        for _, trajectory_indices in prompt_groups.items():
            N = len(trajectory_indices)
            traj_idx = torch.tensor(trajectory_indices, device=all_returns.device)

            if N == 1:
                # Single trajectory - no baseline (keep original reward as advantage)
                baselines[traj_idx[0]] = 0.0
                continue

            # Extract group data
            w_group = all_w_values[traj_idx]  # [shape: (N, max_response_length)]
            R_group = all_returns[traj_idx]  # [shape: (N, max_response_length)]
            # Direct optimal baseline - single value for all in group
            b_star = (R_group * w_group).sum(dim=0) / (w_group.sum(dim=0) + epsilon)
            # Convert to match baselines dtype (epsilon can cause float64 promotion)
            baselines[traj_idx] = b_star.to(baselines.dtype)

            if handle_zero_tail:
                # Optionally zero out the portion of the longest trajectory that extends
                # beyond the second-longest trajectory in the prompt group.
                response_lengths_group = response_lengths[traj_idx]
                sorted_lengths, _ = torch.sort(response_lengths_group)
                max_length = int(sorted_lengths[-1].item())
                second_max_length = int(sorted_lengths[-2].item())
                max_length_idx = (response_lengths_group == max_length).nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]
